_about: Synthetic extraction cases modelled on real mail layouts observed 2026-10-10 (docs/_research/2026-10-10_package-tracking.md, Validation). Every name, address, order id and tracking number is fake; tracking numbers are generated to pass (or deliberately fail) the jkeen/tracking_number_data check digits.

cases.name: walmart_fulfilled_by_walmart_shipped
cases.subject: Shipped: Example Vitamin Chews...
cases.plain:
Order date: Mon, Sep 14, 2026
Order number: 2000111-11111111
# Your package shipped, Alex!
Track package
Arrives Wed, Sep 16
Sold by Example Pro Seller | Fulfilled by Walmart
Track your package: 55511014564076268801
cases.note: Walmart last-mile number: 20 digits, '555' prefix, no public carrier. All links are encrypted w-mt.co redirects.

cases.name: walmart_555_number_that_collides_with_usps20_checksum
cases.subject: Shipped: Example Washer Mat...
cases.plain:
Order number: 2000222-22222222
Sold by Example Seller | Fulfilled by Walmart
Track your package: 55511014564076268800
cases.note: Passes the USPS 20 mod10 check by chance (1 in 10 do). Sender rule must win over the checksum classifier, or this is polled against USPS and never resolves.

cases.note: No tracking number: correlate to the shipped package by order number. Same-subject OFD mails from different orders get merged into one Gmail thread, so threadId is not a key.

We shipped your order, but more packages may be on the way.
Track My Order

cases.note: No number anywhere: create an order-level package with a deep link to the merchant status page; it can only go stale, never delivered, unless the user resolves it.

cases.name: shopify_template_custom_domain_usps_impb_with_zip_prefix
cases.subject: A shipment from order 00000001 has been delivered
cases.plain: Order 00000001 Your order has been delivered Haven't received your package yet? Let us know View your order or Visit our store USPS tracking number: 420000009400136207595275536669 Items in this shipment
cases.note: Shopify's stock shipping template, sent from the store's own domain. Detect by subject shape 'A shipment from order X is on the way|is out for delivery|has been delivered' and the '<Carrier> tracking number:' label, not by sender. USPS IMpb may carry a 420+ZIP routing prefix; store the full string, match on the trailing 22 digits.

cases.name: order_number_matches_checksumless_carrier_pattern
cases.subject: Example Lab | Your order has been sent | Order number: 30000000000000
cases.plain: Your shipping service: UPS Your parcel number: 1Z9X9X9X0326709847 Order number: 30000000000000
cases.note: The 14-digit order number matches DHL E-Commerce (14), which has no checksum in jkeen. Checksumless patterns may only fire next to a carrier label; the labeled 'Order number' must be excluded.

cases.name: tracking_number_only_in_href
cases.subject: Shop Order #XXXXXXXXXX has Shipped
cases.plain: Your Shop Order has Shipped Track Order Order Number XXXXXXXXXX
cases.note: Number exists only in an unwrapped carrier URL; the href tier is the only way to get it.

cases.name: amazon_mcf_tba_inside_wrapped_link
cases.subject: Your ExampleDirect order 2000000000000000000 has shipped
cases.plain: Your package will arrive: Friday, September 11 Track package
cases.note: Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment for a third-party brand. The awstrack wrapper URL-encodes the target, so percent-decoding the path recovers swiship.com/track?id=. TBA has no checksum and no public API: email-only status.

cases.name: ebay_no_tracking_number
cases.subject: Your package is now with its carrier!
cases.plain: Shipped with USPS Carrier: USPS Order number: 00-00000-00000 Estimated delivery Thu, Sep 24
cases.note: eBay names the carrier but hides the number; eBay's own OUT FOR DELIVERY and ORDER DELIVERED mails carry status. Order-level package keyed by eBay order number (subject only names the item, so correlate by item title prefix plus recency when no order number is present).
